title: Secure software development lifecycle
description: Engineering checks for teams adding security review to design, implementation and release.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-218, Secure Software Development Framework 1.1

rules.instruction: For changes to identity, permissions or data flows, name the actors and trust boundaries before proposing an implementation.
rules.verification: Review the diagram or change notes with the security owner and record any required controls.

rules.instruction: Apply access checks at service boundaries and handle rejected access without exposing protected data.
rules.verification: Run the project's authorized access-control tests for allowed access, insufficient permissions and tenant isolation where relevant.

rules.instruction: Use approved secret storage and redact sensitive values from logs, test data and AI inputs.
rules.verification: Review configuration, fixtures and new logging paths. Run the repository's secret scanner if configured.

rules.instruction: Review a new dependency's role, release history, license and security advisories before adding it.
rules.verification: Record the dependency review and run the project's approved dependency checks on the proposed lockfile.

rules.instruction: Assign an owner and a target date to each unresolved security finding. Follow the release policy for remediation or risk acceptance.
rules.verification: Link blocking findings and any recorded exceptions in the release review.
